chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Mughīrah, from Mūsā ibn Bakr, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The time of Salat al-Ghadah is from the rising of dawn until the rising of the sun.

key_terms.صَلَاةِ ٱلْغَدَاةِ: the dawn prayer, meaning Salat al-Fajr
key_terms.طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ: sunrise, which marks the end of the prayer’s time
key_terms.طُلُوعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ: the appearance of true dawn marking the start of fajr time
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the prescribed time or period for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: What is the time of Salat al-Fajr according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the time window for Salat al-Ghadah, identifying it as beginning at the rise of dawn and continuing until sunrise. It is a jurisprudential report that defines the valid time for performing the fajr prayer.
